verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents `vastai search offers` as the way to query prices programmatically, with filters such as `rentable=true` for availability and sorting by price-performance. The same `search_offers` call is exposed in the Python SDK, and all of it sits on a documented REST API with a live OpenAPI spec, so an agent can browse the marketplace catalog before renting. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific REST search-offers endpoint and its price/availability response fields, clarity on whether the catalog query needs no API key or spend, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic catalog queries.
